authoredSolutions.1: For a product of powers \(Z=\dfrac{A^{2}B^{3}}{C^{4}}\) the fractional errors add, each weighted by the MAGNITUDE of its exponent (errors never cancel): \[\frac{\Delta Z}{Z}=\frac{2\Delta A}{A}+\frac{3\Delta B}{B}+\frac{4\Delta C}{C}\] The minus sign of the exponent of \(C\) does not carry over to the error, so the correct choice is C.

Hence the correct choice is C.

The correct choice is B.
